name: Otoko no Ko Datte Dekiru mon! ~Wonderful Haramase Life~
original_name: おとこの娘だってデキるもん！ ～ワンダフル孕ませライフ～
source: The leading character, Maki Takasaki, who goes to the Kumagaya Gakuen  an all boys' school, witnesses things that doubt his eyes on the way back from the school. It was a cute girl in mini skit  with a striped knee socks that had a sign written "Please take me" !
translation: 主人公高崎真希就读于熊谷学园——一所男子学校。放学回家的路上，他目睹了令他难以置信的一幕：一个穿着迷你裙和条纹过膝袜的可爱女孩，身上挂着一块写着“请把我带走”的牌子！
